name: MMVP
intro: MMVP 从 ImageNet-1K 与 LAION-Aesthetics 形成候选图像对，并行计算 CLIP ViT-L-14 与 DINOv2 ViT-L-14 表征，只保留 CLIP 余弦相似度大于 0.95 且 DINOv2 相似度小于 0.6 的“CLIP 盲点对”。人工检查后为每对图像编写两道直接、无歧义的问题，得到 150 对图像、300 道题；论文再用 GPT-4 将问题与选项归纳为九类视觉模式。官方仓库判分器逐题取得 GPT-4 的 yes/no 判断，连续两题都严格判为 yes 时该图像对才计分。
org: New York University, FAIR at Meta, University of California Berkeley
build_method: 双编码器并行筛选, 人工检查与配对编题
eval_feature: CLIP盲点, 独立问答, GPT-4严格yes/no判题, 两题全对计分
build_method_en: Parallel Dual-encoder Filtering, Human Pair Inspection and Question Writing
eval_feature_en: CLIP blind pairs, independent QA, strict GPT-4 yes/no grading, both-questions-correct scoring
intro_en: MMVP forms candidate pairs from ImageNet-1K and LAION-Aesthetics, computes CLIP ViT-L-14 and DINOv2 ViT-L-14 representations in parallel, and retains only pairs with CLIP cosine similarity above 0.95 and DINOv2 similarity below 0.6. Human inspection and paired question writing produce 150 image pairs and 300 direct, unambiguous questions; the paper then uses GPT-4 to organize the questions and options into nine visual patterns. In the official repository grader, a pair receives credit only when GPT-4 returns an exact yes judgment for both consecutive items.

drawio_review_note: Primary-source audit pinned the paper to arXiv:2401.06209v2 (revised 2024-04-25), the official repository to commit 763500597e65c3446f09047837ceda76f4e264bf, and the public MMVP Hugging Face dataset to revision 37eafecab8a3940c50c2ade5b36de69dbc99a8cf. Paper §2.1 says candidate images come from ImageNet and LAION-Aesthetics and that CLIP ViT-L-14 and DINOv2 ViT-L-14 similarities are computed for each pair; the retained-pair condition is conjunctive and strict: CLIP cosine similarity exceeds 0.95 while DINOv2 similarity is below 0.6. The source diagram therefore uses parallel encoder branches rather than the former false CLIP-to-DINO sequence. Paper §2.2 and Figure 2 support manual inspection, identification of the visual detail missed by CLIP, one direct and unambiguous question per image, 150 image pairs, and 300 questions. Paper §3.1 supplies the GPT-4 prompt over questions and options and the nine named visual patterns; this is an analysis branch, not an extra filtering stage. Paper §2.3 states that model questions are presented independently. At the pinned repository, scripts/evaluate_mllm.py supplies the LLaVA-specific runner defaults (temperature 0.2, one beam, sampled decoding, maximum 1,024 new tokens), while scripts/gpt_grader.py uses gpt-4-0314 at temperature 0.2, requests only yes/no, accepts only the case-insensitive exact regex yes or no, maps every other string to an unresolved grade, groups consecutive records in twos, and credits a pair only when both grades are yes. API exceptions retry without a terminal cap. The metric is therefore credited consecutive pairs divided by 150; a non-yes/no grade is not credited. Appendix B.4 separately reports four volunteers, all 300 questions in randomized order, and 95.7% mean question accuracy, so the diagram does not merge that item-level human result into the repository pair metric. The pinned HF release contains 300 images and a 301-line Questions.csv including its header, and its card declares MIT. The repository README also claims MIT but its root LICENSE link is absent at the pinned commit (only the vendored LLaVA license exists), so repository-license and upstream ImageNet/LAION image-rights claims are not broadened beyond the observable sources. Formal publication evidence [site-a11p-paper-alignment]: normalized Draw.io and architecture sidecars plus native fixed-light SVG/PNG pairs were regenerated from the checked-in bilingual specs. Final PNG dimensions are 3061×681 (English) and 3061×681 (Chinese); SVG viewBoxes are 3059×679 and 3059×679. The final exports were inspected without clipping, node overlap, connector-node crossing, fallback text, or adaptive colors.
